# testing_x_soft_delete_property (Resource)

XSoftDeleteProperty Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_soft_delete_property" "my_xsoftdeleteproperty" {
  non_soft_delete_property_request_and_response = "...my_non_soft_delete_property_request_and_response..."
  non_soft_delete_property_request_only         = "...my_non_soft_delete_property_request_only..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `non_soft_delete_property_request_and_response` (String) Non x-speakeasy-soft-delete-property that should remain configurable.
- `non_soft_delete_property_request_only` (String) Non x-speakeasy-soft-delete-property that should remain configurable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `non_soft_delete_property_response_only` (String) Non x-speakeasy-soft-delete-property that should remain as read-only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_soft_delete_property.my_testing_x_soft_delete_property
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_soft_delete_property.my_testing_x_soft_delete_property "..."
```
